deposits.note: Genesis deposit: credited by hand into deployments/state.json before batch #0 (see usage.json seed-state step), before the deposit watcher existed. Recorded here so the watcher never credits it twice.

note: Deposit watcher state (scripts/deposit-watcher.ts). Deposits are identified by (transaction hash, log index); a deposit already recorded here is never credited again, however often the watcher re-scans. Statuses: pending (seen on-chain, awaiting the next settle), settled (credited by a batch), genesis (credited by hand before the watcher existed), skipped (seen but not creditable — e.g. a non-whole-uqor amount; funds stay in the contract).
